item_name: Rothco Rechargeable LED Tactical Task Light with Zoom - 1500 Lumens
item_short_desc: Rothco’s 1500 Lumen LED Tactical Task Light features a powerful field of vision that can be expanded or contracted via the convenient zoom capability. This tactical flashlight is perfect for public safety professionals, everyday use, and the great outdoors.
description: Rothco’s 1500 Lumen LED Tactical Task Light features a powerful field of vision that can be expanded or contracted via the convenient zoom capability. The powerful 10W 1500 lumen XHP70 LED tactical flashlight is perfect for indoors, outdoors, work tasks, and more. The LED on the rechargeable flashlight features 5 light modes: high, mid, low, flare, and SOS. The LED flashlight’s zoom capability enables you to expand or contract the field of illumination as needed, and it is also built with IP4X water-resistant that protects against splashing. The camping flashlight is powered by a rechargeable 18650 lithium-ion battery. The outdoor flashlight comes with a USB-C charger as well as an adapter for compatibility with three AAA batteries. The flashlight measures 6 3/5 inches x 2 inches x 1 ½ inches.
